title: A spin-polarized analysis of the half-metallicity, mechanical, structural and optoelectronic attributes of full-Heusler XVCo2 (X = B and P) alloys
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34679-34689
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06555G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Faiza Firdous, Quratul Ain, Shams A. M. Issa, Hesham M. H. Zakaly, Junaid Munir
The structural, electromagnetic, mechanical, and optical characteristics are determined through first-principles calculations. The computed properties reveal the potential of BVCo2 and PVCo2 spintronics and optoelectronic devices.
